verdict.rationale: The official Lium CLI is hosted in a public GitHub repository (Datura-ai/lium), and an agent skill file is served from a public GitHub repo, so some client-side source is readable. Nothing in the evidence states a license, and the core marketplace/platform source is not shown to be public. missing for 10: any evidence of an open-source license, evidence that the platform/backend source (not just the CLI/skill) is published, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
